propositions: An Analyzer protocol and AnalyzerResult type must be defined with optional loc, complexity, and duplication fields to support language-agnostic code health analysis.

resolve_analyzer(lang) must return None when no analyzer is configured for a given language, and a fallback helper must return Unavailable(reason, accruing_since) without scanning paths or fabricating data.
The implementation must reuse the existing Unavailable sentinel from rebar.metrics.registry with reason and accruing_since parameters, never inventing a single-argument variant.
No side effects on import: the analyzer module must not register entries into the REGISTRY as a consequence of being imported.
The ANALYZERS map and resolution logic must use distinct naming (not 'registry') to avoid collision with the existing metrics/registry.py module.
